verdict.rationale: A live probe returns HTTP 200 for https://serpapi.com/llms.txt with a SerpApi summary. Doc pages are served as agent-friendly markdown variants: search-api.md was probed, and integrations.md, markdown-output.md, pricing.md and many per-engine .md pages appear. An agent can therefore be pointed directly at LLM-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and evidence of the llms.txt's full depth and structure beyond its header.
